title: Cohort Release Windows and Evaluation Signal Artefact for Hosted API + Model Registry
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Define a repeatable quarterly approach that groups endpoints/models into small cohorts for staggered release windows, and produce a versioned 'evaluation signal artefact' (ESS) that captures the minimum set of prompts, behavioral checks, and SLO thresholds required to validate a model swap for Hosted API routes and the model registry. The artefact should be machine-readable, small enough to run in CI, and extensible for future quality detectors (toxicity, steerability, fact-checking).
goals: Enable deterministic canary and ramp decisions with a 24–72h decision cadence for cohorts
Create an ESS bundle per model candidate that includes: canonical prompt set (~120 prompts), scoring rubric, acceptance thresholds, and a lightweight traffic simulator
Reduce full-fleet rollback rate due to quality regressions by 60% quarter-over-quarter
Tie ESS pass/fail signals to console alerts and automatic hold policies for Dedicated/Private lanes
rollout_plan: Define cohorts: Critical (payment/auth), High (chat/core product flows), Low (experiments/internal-only)
Staging validation: run ESS in staging GPUs against pinned traffic snapshot
Canary: 1% traffic to cohort for 12–48 hours, run live ESS and observability checks
Ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over configurable windows if ESS and runtime SLOs pass
Automatic fallback: if ESS fails or runtime latency/cost thresholds breached, route to previous model variant
acceptance_criteria: ESS schema documented and stored in model registry; schema v1.0 committed
Automated CI job that validates ESS against a model candidate and returns pass/fail exit codes
Console integration: cohort-level status and ESS pass/fail shown on model detail page
Runbook for manual override + emergency rollback verified by SRE and Product
metrics_and_signals: Quality: ESS pass rate, delta on prompt-level scoring, hallucination flagged by spec tests
Runtime: token-cost delta, median latency P50/P95, error rate
User impact: percent of requests with degraded structured output or function-call failures
Business: estimated cost per 1M tokens and downstream feature availability impact
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: ESS may overfit to curated prompts -> Mitigation: include synthetic adversarial prompts and periodic blind audits
Risk: CI runtime cost spikes for large models -> Mitigation: run sampled evaluation and prioritize quick-fail checks first
Risk: Cohort misclassification leading to customer-facing regressions -> Mitigation: maintain a path to escalate cohorts to 'critical' with immediate rollback policies
notes: Prototype ESS schema proposed in Design doc (link below). We intentionally limit initial prompt set to ~120 prompts to keep CI under 2 hours for most model sizes.
This ticket scopes schema + orchestration integration; model-specific evaluation bundles are tracked as sub-issues after v1 is agreed.
Plan to coordinate with Dedicated and Private PMs to ensure release windows respect customer SLAs and on-prem upgrade constraints.
